description: This file defines custom Cypress commands to mock API responses, facilitate UI login, and seed authentication tokens for end-to-end testing of a web dashboard application.

methods.name: mockApi
methods.description: Sets up intercepts to mock API endpoints for login, users, reports, and charts, returning static or dynamically generated data for testing purposes.

methods.name: loginUI
methods.description: Automates UI login by filling in credentials and submitting the login form.

methods.name: seedAuth
methods.description: Stores a fake JWT token directly in localStorage to simulate an authenticated session.
